name: SandForge Companion
author: InfinityTheHoly
description:
SandForge Companion is the Workshop companion for the SandForge loader. Official Sandkit can load this item on its own.

Without the loader: the main menu shows SandForge not active and a GitHub install link. Badge and docs still work.

With the loader: SandForge Active, live statuses, API docs, and an arcade (Vein Snake, Puddle Tank, Shaft Sweeper, Silt Sort, Klondike).

The loader is a separate Workshop item (sandustry.sandforge-loader). After subscribe, quit the game and run install.cmd from that folder.

SandForge Toolkit is a separate Workshop item. It does not require the loader.

Created by InfinityTheHoly. Unofficial. Not affiliated with Sandustry or its developers.
